message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** representing the thirteen American colonies. These men served as the Founding Fathers who formally adopted the document on July 4, 1776. Some of the most well‑known signers include:

| State | Notable Signers |
|-------|-----------------|
| Delaware | George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| Pennsylvania | Benjamin Franklin, John Dickinson, Thomas Jefferson |
| New Jersey | William Livingston, John Witherspoon |
| Georgia | James Jackson, Joseph Claypoole |
| Connecticut | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington |
| Massachusetts | John Adams, Samuel Adams, Paul Revere |
| Maryland | Charles Carroll, Daniel Carroll |
| South Carolina | Edward Rutledge, Charles Pinckney |
| New Hampshire | John Langdon, John Sullivan |
| Virginia | Patrick Henry, George Mason, Thomas Jefferson |
| North Carolina | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes |
| Rhode Island | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery |
| New York | William Floyd, Philip Schuyler |

These individuals, among others, signed the Declaration at the Second Continental Congress in Philadelphia.
